taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-04 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 4201.4 | 5.06 | 5.06
2 | 2238.9 | 4.35 | 9.41
3 | 343.9 | 31.91 | 41.32
4 | 25.0 | 0.99 | 42.31
5 | 10.9 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-04
Curve type: Q-type (ρ1 > ρ2 > ρ3 > ρ4 > ρ5, continuously descending resistivity sequence)
Aquifer depth: 41.3 m – 42.3 m (thin low-resistivity zone, layer 4) grading into a thicker, more productive saturated zone below 42.3 m (layer 5, resistivity 10.9 ohm-m, unbounded at depth)

Recommendation: Case and seal the borehole through the resistive overburden (0–41.3 m) to prevent cross-contamination, then advance drilling past 42.3 m to confirm and screen the low-resistivity aquifer zone; verify lithology with cuttings/logging since layer 4 is thin and may represent a transitional clayey/saturated horizon rather than the main water-bearing unit.
